SELECT T.RNUM, T.ESTIMATE_NO, T.STORE_ORDER_NO, T.ESTIMATE_TITLE, T.FILE_GROUP_NO, T.ESTIMATE_DATE , T.FILE_GROUP_NM, T.FILE_REGDATE, T.FILE_GROUP_TY, T.FILE_NO, T.FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME , T.FILE_SAVE_NAME, T.FILE_EXT, T.FILE_SIZE, T.FILE_SAVE_LOCATE, T.FILE_MIME , T.FILE_FANCYSIZE, T.FILE_SAVE_DATE, T.FILE_DOWNCOUNT FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY STORE_ORDER_NO) AS RNUM, E.ESTIMATE_NO, E.STORE_ORDER_NO, E.ESTIMATE_TITLE, E.FILE_GROUP_NO, E.ESTIMATE_DATE, FG.FILE_GROUP_NM, FG.FILE_REGDATE, FG.FILE_GROUP_TY, FD.FILE_NO, FD.FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME, FD.FILE_SAVE_NAME, FD.FILE_EXT, FD.FILE_SIZE, FD.FILE_SAVE_LOCATE, FD.FILE_MIME, FD.FILE_FANCYSIZE, FD.FILE_SAVE_DATE, FD.FILE_DOWNCOUNT FROM ESTIMATE E LEFT JOIN FILE_GROUP FG ON E.FILE_GROUP_NO = FG.FILE_GROUP_NO LEFT JOIN FILE_DETAIL FD ON FG.FILE_GROUP_NO = FD.FILE_GROUP_NO WHERE 1 = 1
) T WHERE T.RNUM BETWEEN (#{currentPage} * 10) - (10-1) AND (#{currentPage} *10)
